method: Existing official Lighthouse13.5.0 CLI, mobile simulated throttling, fresh browser/storage per run; alternating paired arm order; same loopback gzip adapter; public production data read-only; server and external cache coldness not asserted. exploratory: measurements is the rejected first-cover high-priority experiment, not final shipped code; baseline healthy route measurements retained. An initially incorrect /en/toplists path returned404; corrected to the existing sitemap /en/toplijsten route and failed receipt retained.
final: Both measured performance candidates are REJECTED from the release diff. Historical folder names measurements-final/alternate refer to candidate B, not final release code. Final release changes only optional-provider quota handling; no LCP, UI, stylesheet or image-selection change is claimed.
